chars.ILYAS: ILYAS: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jeans and white sneakers.
chars.TAWA: TAWA: a young man wearing a red tracksuit jacket with white side stripes, grey sweatpants and a black cap worn backwards.
chars.SARA: SARA: a young woman wearing a lilac headscarf and a long light-pink coat.
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: an older woman with short blonde curly hair (the only character with hair), wearing a green blazer and pearl necklace.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A cafe terrace in a blue-painted street of Chefchaouen. SARA smiles lovingly and holds ILYAS's hand across the table; ILYAS sweats nervously; TAWA sits beside them, leaning back with a sly knowing smirk, looking straight at ILYAS. Awkward comic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS sits on a rooftop in Chefchaouen at dusk, head in his hands, stressed, crumpled papers and an empty wallet beside him, blue houses and mountains behind.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan notary office with wooden desk and stamped documents: ILYAS awkwardly signs a marriage contract next to BRIDE, who smiles proudly holding a foreign passport; ILYAS looks uncomfortable and forced. Comic awkward moment.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS and SARA walk happily side by side in a blue alley of Chefchaouen, laughing, SARA holding an ice cream, ILYAS carrying her bag. Romantic mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a park, SARA hugs ILYAS happily with her eyes closed, while ILYAS behind her back secretly slips a gold wedding ring off his finger into his pocket, looking guilty and nervous.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Jemaa el-Fna square in Marrakech in the evening with food stalls and smoke: TAWA happily eats a big plate of grilled skewers while ILYAS pays the vendor with a sad face, holding out banknotes.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Marrakech riad bedroom with zellige tiles: ILYAS sleeps on the bed in the background; in the foreground TAWA secretly scrolls through ILYAS's phone with a sneaky grin.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On a Marrakech riad terrace: TAWA talks on the phone with a mischievous grin, one hand on his hip, whispering; behind him through an open doorway ILYAS, unaware, brushes his teeth in a mirror.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SARA stands in her family's Moroccan living room with sedari sofas, holding a phone to her ear, completely shocked, mouth wide open, her other hand dropping a cup of tea that spills.
